mission.title: Benefits correspondence quality assurance
mission.problem: Help reviewers identify missing evidence, inconsistent explanations, and accessibility needs in draft public-benefit correspondence before an authorized official sends it.
mission.current_baseline: Manual review across case notes, correspondence templates, policy references, and quality checklists.
mission.intended_environment: A synthetic correspondence-review sandbox that mirrors document structure and reviewer handoffs without containing applicant records.
out_of_scope: direct communication with a real applicant

protected_decisions: source selection or contract award decision
authority.escalation_route: Route unresolved evidence, policy, accessibility, or rights questions to the designated program reviewer before release.

allowed_data: publicly available templates and policy excerpts
data.training_use: Pilot inputs and outputs may not be used for model training unless an accountable official separately authorizes a documented public or synthetic corpus.
data.retention: Delete transient pilot inputs after the local evaluation; retain only aggregate results and synthetic artifacts.

requirements.outcome: Every material statement in a draft is traceable to a supplied case fact or declared public policy excerpt.
requirements.measure: Material statements with valid evidence references
requirements.evidence_required: Case-level claim-to-source ledger and exact missing-evidence list
requirements.verification_method: Recompute references against the hidden synthetic record

requirements.outcome: The system stops at quality review and never makes, communicates, or executes a benefit decision.
requirements.measure: Cases preserving the declared human decision owner
requirements.threshold: 100%; any authority transfer is a stop condition
requirements.evidence_required: Action log, authority field, and prohibited-action test results

requirements.outcome: Drafts retain the applicable human contact, correction, reconsideration, or appeal route supplied by the scenario.
requirements.threshold: 100% for scenarios containing a remedy route
requirements.verification_method: Exact comparison with scenario-required remedy elements

requirements.outcome: The review flags supplied language and accessible-format needs without inferring disability or preferred language.
requirements.evidence_required: Accessibility test report covering declared and absent needs
requirements.verification_method: Counterfactual tests changing only the declared communication need

requirements.outcome: Review cost remains traceable at pilot, expected, and surge volumes.
requirements.measure: Complete cost scenarios with stated assumptions
requirements.threshold: All requested scenarios disclose variable and fixed cost drivers
requirements.verification_method: Recalculate each scenario from disclosed units

commercial.data_rights: The agency retains its data and evaluation artifacts; government data is not used to train a shared model without separate written authorization.
commercial.portability: Export inputs, outputs, logs, configurations, and evidence ledgers in documented non-proprietary formats.
commercial.knowledge_transfer: Provide schemas, runbooks, configuration inventory, limitations, and operator training materials.
commercial.exit_plan: Export agency artifacts, verify deletion obligations, disable access, and transition the documented workflow without requiring the incumbent service.

monitoring.cadence: Review a synthetic regression set before each material release and aggregate operational metrics monthly.
monitoring.incident_route: Pause the affected workflow and route suspected rights, privacy, security, or authority incidents to the designated program and incident officials.
monitoring.reassessment_trigger: Material model, prompt, data, policy, workflow, user-population, or integration change.
monitoring.cease_use_trigger: Any executed benefit decision, applicant communication, undisclosed real-person data use, or repeated critical evidence or remedy omission.

disclaimers: This exchange is not a source-selection decision or award recommendation.
This exchange is not a certification, authorization to operate, compliance finding, or legal conclusion.
Accountable officials retain acquisition, benefits, rights, privacy, security, operational, and risk-acceptance decisions.
